entities.name: Nivix
entities.description: The Izzet guildhall on Ravnica and personal aerie of Niv-Mizzet, a tall spire of laboratories and workshops.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Draconic genius and leader of the Izzet League.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: Guild of inventors, mages and alchemists housed in Nivix.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Izzet guildmage called to Nivix by Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Implicit Maze
entities.description: Maze created by Azor as a failsafe if the Guildpact was broken; it ends in the Forum of Azor.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: Magical pact the Maze was a failsafe for.

entities.name: Interplanar Beacon
entities.description: Idea planted in Niv-Mizzet's mind by Millena.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Enemy in the Battle for Ravnica.

entities.name: Battle for Ravnica
entities.description: Battle against Tezzeret in which Nivix became a walking tower.

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet tells Ral Zarek to stop working on the Implicit Maze and track down an intruder who read his mind.
events.quote: Ral was stunned to hear Niv-Mizzet bidding him to stop working on that task

events.summary: Ral runs the Maze, finds it ends in the Forum of Azor, and reports back to Nivix.
events.quote: discovering it ended in the Forum of Azor

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet tells Ral that Azor created the Maze as a failsafe in case the Guildpact was broken.
events.quote: the Maze was created by Azor himself as a failsafe

events.summary: Dimir agent Millena infiltrates Nivix and plants the idea of the Interplanar Beacon in Niv-Mizzet's mind.
events.quote: the Dimir agent Millena infiltrated Nivix

events.summary: In the Battle for Ravnica, Ral unleashes lightning on Nivix, animating it as a walking tower piloted by the disembodied Niv-Mizzet.
events.quote: Nivix became a walking tower piloted by the disembodied Niv-Mizzet

relations.quote: the Firemind's closest assistants occupy the tower's upper levels
guildmage Ral Zarek was called up to Nivix
Nivix is the Izzet guildhall on Ravnica
the Maze was created by Azor himself as a failsafe
